senses.gloss: गरल gara-la, n. poison.
गरलाय garalā-ya, Ā. become poison.

गारुड gāruḍa, a. having the form of, referring 🞄to or coming from Garuḍa;
 n. emerald.
गरुडाय garuḍā-ya, Ā. become Garuḍa.

गर्ग garga, m. N. of various men;
 ā, ī, f. N..

गर्गर gár-gar-a, m. whirlpool;
 ā, ī, f. churn.
गर्ज garj-a, m., ˚न -na, n. roar, din.
गर्ताश्रय garta‿āśraya, m. animal living in 🞄holes.
गर्द् GARD, Ⅰ. P. garda, shout, exult.
गर्द gárd-a, a. hungry.

गर्दभ garda-bhá, m. ass: ī́, f. she-ass;
 🞄(-bha) -ratha, m. car drawn by asses.

गार्दभ gārdabha, a. referring to an ass;
 🞄drawn by asses (yāna).
गर्भिन् garbh-in, a. pregnant (also fig.), with 🞄(ac., in.): (ṇ)-ī, f. pregnant woman.
गर्भेश्वर garbha‿īśvara, m. hereditary sovereign: 🞄-tā, f., -tva, n. hereditary dominion.
गर्भैकादश garbha‿ekādaśa, m. pl. eleventh 🞄year after conception.
गर्मुत् garmút, f. kind of wild bean.

गर्व gar-va, m. pride: -ṃ kṛ or yā, become 🞄haughty;
 -gir, f. pl. haughty speeches, 🞄vauntings.
गारुत्मत gārutmata, a. referable or sacred to 🞄Garuḍa: w. aśman, emerald (as an antidote).

गार्त्समद gārtsamad-a, a. referring to Gṛtsamada;
 🞄m. pat. descendant of Gṛtsamada.
गार्द्ध्य gārddh-ya, n. greed.
गार्हपत gārhapatá, n. dignity of a householder.
गार्ह्य gārh-ya, a. domestic.
